showcase.title: Supported by
showcase.subtitle: Sponsors, partners, and collaborators supporting sustainable research

lock.title: Premium service
lock.hint: This feature is available to Sponsor, Partner, and Collaborator members.

verified_listing.title: Verified listings
verified_listing.desc: A Verified badge on Innovation Marketplace listings. Members get a free yearly verification quota; others pay a listing fee.

featured_listing.title: Featured listings
featured_listing.desc: Listings posted by members are pinned to the top of the Innovation Marketplace with a Featured ribbon.

partner_showcase.title: Partner showcase
partner_showcase.desc: Member logos and links appear on the home page and the Innovation Marketplace.

institution_report.title: Institution report
institution_report.desc: Download an institution SDG report (researchers, publications, SDG distribution) as CSV.

data_export.title: Data export
data_export.desc: Download your personal statistics (views, citations, activity) as CSV.

priority_matching.title: Priority matching
priority_matching.desc: Member profiles are shown first in Research Matching for organisations looking for partners.

analysis_quota.title: Unlimited re-analysis
analysis_quota.desc: Non-members can re-run SDG analysis {{count}} times a day; members without limit. Stored data stays open to everyone.

page.title: Sciecola Premium Services
page.subtitle: Support sustainable research and get extra services for your organisation.
page.free_desc: Sciecola has not enabled premium services yet. Every feature is available to everyone at no cost.
always_free: Applying to and posting opportunities (under review)

tier_desc.sponsor: For organisations that want maximum visibility and to support the platform.
tier_desc.partner: For research and industry organisations actively seeking collaboration.
tier_desc.collaborator: For research groups, labs, and organisations getting started.

page.contact_desc: Contact the Sciecola team to choose a plan and activate your membership.
page.contact_fallback: Send a message through the Contact page.
page.my_quota: Verification quota this year: {{used}} of {{quota}} used

admin.title: Premium Services
admin.description: Master switch for premium services, which features become premium, and Sponsor/Partner/Collaborator memberships.
admin.state_on_desc: Checked features below are for members only (or paid). Badges and the partner showcase are shown.
admin.state_off_desc: Premium is not enabled: every feature is free for everyone; badges and the partner showcase are hidden.
admin.confirm_on: Enable premium services? Checked features will be limited to members and listing verification will start charging a fee.
admin.confirm_off: Disable premium services? Every feature becomes free for everyone again.
admin.features_title: Features that become premium when active
admin.pricing_note: Pricing/plan note (shown on the Premium page)
admin.pricing_ph: E.g. Sponsor IDR … /year, Partner IDR … /year, Collaborator IDR … /year
admin.fee_hint: The listing verification fee and payment instructions are set in the Opportunity Curation tab.

f.institution_hint: Same as the ID in the institution page address, e.g. /institutions/<ID>. Leave empty if not tied to an institution.

admin.link_hint: Link an account (email) or ORCID so the badge appears and the user gets the features.
